title: Apocalypse Shooting Experience in Las Vegas
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: minimum age to participate is 18 years old.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the thrill of the Apocalypse Shooting Package, where you can shoot outdoors with the comfort of a climate-controlled indoor firing line. This action-packed experience includes 12 powerful firearms, from handguns to sniper rifles, and targets ranging from 25 to 200 yards, including the exciting chance to shoot at exploding targets. Plus, enjoy the convenience of round-trip transportation from Las Vegas, ensuring a seamless and unforgettable adventure.
